_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Mo ye Player {player_id} tî gbätä Liar's Dice tî {num_players} zo gbätä.
Kötä gbätä:
- Tî kotä, mo pendere:
  1) Fä gbätä bid tî kotä quantity tî kotä face (tî kotä) tî current bid; ö [Bid: 3, 4],
  2) Kôzo gbätä tî last bid tî '[Call]'.

Tî mo kôzo gbätä:
  - Tî kotä count tî face value tî kotä dice ayeke less tî bid, last bidder ayeke lose one die.
  - Tî kotä, caller ayeke lose one die.
Player tî 0 dice ayeke eliminated. Last remaining player ayeke win.

board.new_round:
Sûri mâbâko - Kozala maboko: {dice_summary}
Maboko ma sûri oyo ezîko: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} kôzo gbätä! Kotä count tî face {face_value} ayeke {count}, tî LESS tî {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (last bidder) ayeke lose one die.
call.caller_loses:
Mbeni {current_player_id} awïri! Kotä {face_value} nzönî {count}, mbënzï {quantity}.
Mbeni {loser_id} (mbeni awïri) akpënzï mbënzï die mõkö.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: A hunda ti tene a mû nginza ni sân ti fa tënë.
invalid_move.invalid_bid: Sandaga so ayeke na lege ni ape: {reason}
invalid_move.not_recognized: Sûri esîkî sêngê tî âkûanda kama '[Bid: X, Y]' tô '[Call]'. Sûri esûri: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Kûnzî tî ângö {new_quantity} ezîko ndî na kûnzî tî âkûi {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Ngûnda tî ângö {new_face_value} ezîko ndî na ngûnda tî âkûi {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: A yeke oko na ti so a mû ni fadeso.
bid_reason.face_range: A lingbi nengo ti aye ni aduti na popo 1 na 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: A zi {player_id} na lege ti mbeni ye so ayeke nzoni pëpe.
